name: PyTorch
description: An open source machine learning framework supported by the Linux Foundation with widespread research adoption.

name: Transformers (Hugging Face)
description: State-of-the-art Machine Learning library for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX providing unified model architectures.

name: vLLM
description: High-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
lead_maintainer_or_secretariat: vLLM Core Team & UC Berkeley LMSYS

name: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
description: Open ecosystem for interchangeable AI models across hardware runtimes and frameworks.

name: scikit-learn
description: Predictive data analysis tool built on NumPy, SciPy, and matplotlib, fundamental to classical statistical ML.

name: llama.cpp
description: Port of LLM inference in C/C++ without external dependencies, widely adopted for edge and local AI deployment.

name: Linux Foundation AI & Data
description: Umbrella foundation supporting open source AI, machine learning, and data innovation.

name: European Commission
description: The executive body of the European Union responsible for drafting and enforcing the EU AI Act.

name: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21
description: Joint Technical Committee 21 on Artificial Intelligence tasked with drafting harmonised European standards supporting the EU AI Act.

name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42
description: International standards committee establishing global foundational standards on Artificial Intelligence (ISO/IEC 42001, 22989, 5338).

name: NIST AI Safety Consortium (AISIC)
description: Consortium supporting the US AI Safety Institute to develop science-based standards, guidelines, and red-teaming benchmarks.

name: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE-SA)
description: Global standardisation body leading ethical and technical AI specifications including IEEE 7000 series and P2801.

name: EU AI Act (Regulation EU 2024/1689)
description: Comprehensive regulatory framework establishing risk-based obligations and harmonised standardisation mandates for AI systems.

name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS)
description: International standard specifying requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an AI management system.
